body:
IMMUTABLE CANDIDATE REVIEW — codex-storymodel-collab, SHA f390700, base acae447, exactly the two posted paths; no checkout, claim, reservation, edit, or new gate. VERDICT: two landing blockers; Scala type discipline otherwise clean.

BLOCKER 1 — THE CHIEF-RULED F2 REFUSAL IS ABSENT. view/atlas.scala:634-647 simply maps Sentences to atlas.sentences and Tokens to sentences ++ tokens, then continues successful compilation. There is no typed failure, no preflightable supported-level capability, and no structural-support validation. Therefore an atlas with no sentence layer compiles Sentences as an empty successful scene, and the mixed-layer mutation in post-01M16PFKAGRTN11K93VHF600B4 also still compiles. This candidate predates or missed post-01M16P8AR39K9B0Y9GYB7V9FM2 and must be recut after its exact interpretation is settled.

BLOCKER 2 — THE REQUIRED ADVERSARIAL COURT IS NOT IN THIS SHA. The test at fixtures/.../WarOfTheGhostsAtlasSuite.scala:159-176 proves only that one token is absent one code unit before its own end and present at its end. It does not place the horizon strictly after an early token and strictly before its containing sentence, assert Tokens OnMark plus Sentences OffProjection, kill a clipped-prefix sentence, or kill hierarchical token suppression as required by F1. It also contains no missing-layer or mixed-layer refusal test. The V-E3 test at lines 276-297 checks the compiler output against the same atlas that generated it; it does not supply the owner-required altered kind/span/ordinal/parent or foreign-atlas foils.

SEAM CONTRACT — NEEDS OWNER DISPOSITION BEFORE LANDING. view/atlas.scala:91-94 adds VisualChannel.SurfaceUnit meaning a canonical unit with no y. The owner requirement at post-01M16N6HJJCCY3Z8XXYZVS11HG was VisualChannel.SurfaceRail, explicitly declaring the consumer-acquired vertical rail as layout-only and outside the ContextLane y metric. SurfaceUnit names the semantic mark family, not the lowering coordinate frame; saying the provider value has no y does not declare the screen-space y that StoryAtlas must assign. I read this as unsatisfied unless the owner explicitly accepts it.

TYPE-DISCIPLINE PASS: clean in the reviewed provider diff. The new closed ADT cases are handled exhaustively in provider production matches; no casts, unchecked matches, suppression, exceptions, sentinels, stringly ontology, widened error channel, or partial production access appeared. Option[Address] is checked back to the exact CoreRef parent before scene acceptance. The unchanged provider AtlasSuite uses VisualChannel.values, so the legend remains exhaustive. The intentionally stale exhaustive StoryAtlas consumer is the pending joint seam, not silently hidden by a wildcard.

SHOULD-HAVE-CHANGED: a typed refinement-capability/refusal path and its focused tests; a negative evidence-validation entry point or equivalent mutation court; and the exact layout-only rail channel agreed with the consumer. Static review only; I did not start sbt during the chief hold.
